teach_en: ຄ is a k with a puff of air, as in 'kite': the same sound as ຂ.
notes: From letters.csv C03 pron_tip (verified) and SOUND_HINTS C03. Kept to one line; R09 explains the two letters. Wording by agent.

teach_en: A short, tight 'oh', like the 'o' in 'boat' said very short. Written ◌ົ above the consonant, with a final letter after it, as in ຄົນ. In ເຂົ້າ the same mark is part of the 'ao' vowel.
notes: From vowels.csv V17 pron_tip (verified: short o before a final consonant; ◌ົ above the consonant) and SOUND_HINTS V17. Shape checked against ຄົນ, ນົມ, ຫົກ. Wording by agent.
